parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: Her bike was parked outside the building
but there was no trace of her inside.
I could just make out my train
perhaps someone would give me a lift.
The twins were dizzy and thirsty
but gulping down all that milk only made them sick.
I was startled when he showed up
his online profile. Tackle, clumsy, occurrence, soggy, munch.

parts.text: Her bike was parked outside the building but there was no trace of her inside. In the distance, I could just make out my train pulling out of the station. I sighed and turned back; perhaps someone would give me a lift. The catering company acknowledges that there's hygiene issue in their kitchens. The twins were dizzy and thirsty from playing in the sun, but gulping down all that milk only made them sick. I was startled when he showed up because he looked nothing like his online profile. Tackle, clumsy, occurrence, soggy, munch.
